correctness.rationale: The map G_epsilon uses q_epsilon=B/(B-1)-epsilon on [0,1/B) and Bx-1 on [1/B,M], M=1/(B-1). The positive invariant step density is the source Theorem 1.3 series with weights along the orbit r=q/B. Before first left-branch visit, x_n=M-epsilon B^{n-1}, w_n=B^{-n}; each of L+1 prefix steps removes exactly epsilon/B mass from a layer adjacent to M. L=log(1/epsilon)/log B+O_B(1), while the remaining series tails have O_B(epsilon) L1 norm. Normalization of Z0=B/(B-1)^2 yields weak signed endpoint concentration C_B(mu0-delta_M), C_B=(B-1)^2/(B^2 log B). The total variation sharp constant 2C_B follows from weak lower semicontinuity plus norm upper bound, and the coordinate mean from the weak limit. Independent 80-digit prefix-identity tests at B=1.5,2,3 and epsilon=1e-18 matched every prefix missing-mass identity and coefficient trends. These tests corroborate, not replace, the uniform geometric-tail proof.
